title: 4 Claude Code features most people never set up
summary: Claude Code reads a CLAUDE.md file in your project into context at the start of every session, so build commands, code style and project rules do not need repeating. Markdown files in .claude/commands become custom slash commands, so a saved prompt like a code review runs as a single slash command. Hooks are shell commands configured in settings.json that run automatically at lifecycle events such as before or after a tool call; a hook can run a linter after every edit or block a tool call. Subagents are defined as Markdown files in .claude/agents with their own instructions and tools, and each one works in its own separate context window, so research or review does not fill up the main conversation.
